perspective:
Arthur’s available information:

- He is Arthur Chung, a plumber who works professionally with Teresa Ortega, a medical assistant, on community service projects.
- During the community service project, he noticed Teresa working hard and seeming overwhelmed. He felt concerned for her well-being and offered help.
- He heard Teresa say it was kind but she thought she could manage, though there was a lot to do.
- He told her self-care mattered and offered to help with tasks so they could finish faster together. Teresa accepted help organizing medical supplies.
- He believed Teresa was hesitant because she wanted to prove her capability. He felt empathetic and wanted to reassure her that accepting help did not undermine her abilities.
- He heard Teresa say she appreciated his point but wanted to show she could do it herself.
- He told her teamwork could make them more effective and that it was not about proving anything. Teresa said she needed to remind herself of that. He said they were in it together.
- He believed Teresa was still struggling and felt frustrated that his help was not yielding results. He wanted another way to support her without making her feel inadequate.
- He told Teresa he could see things were still tough and that she was doing a great job. Teresa said it had been busy and she felt behind.
- He proposed they work together on tasks instead of just him helping her. Teresa agreed. He said they would tackle it as a team.
- He felt hopeful that working together would ease Teresa’s burden and improve efficiency. He committed to the collaborative approach.
- He told Teresa he was hopeful about the collaborative approach. Teresa said it already felt less overwhelming. He suggested he handle inventory while she managed patient records, checking in regularly. Teresa agreed and said she was glad they were doing it together.
- He believed their collaboration strengthened their professional relationship and felt satisfied with the outcome.
- He told Teresa their teamwork had paid off and suggested continuing the collaborative approach in future projects. Teresa agreed it had been a great experience and said they were more efficient and effective as a team. He looked forward to their next project together.
- He heard Teresa thank him for being a supportive colleague.

Arthur’s beliefs about Teresa’s motives or struggles are his own inferences; he only knows what she said or showed him.
